snippet.title: Look to the Birds | Cozy Birdwatching Game - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
A cozy first-person birdwatching game about slowing down, noticing nature, and finding peace in small moments. In this demo, enjoy one of the 5 locations from the full game, and get a taste for birding!

Wishlist & Play the Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4162670/Look_to_the_Birds/
